persona.title: Persona

notFound.title: Persona not found
notFound.description: This persona no longer exists or is not available.

persona.blankTitle: You don't seem to have any persona.
persona.blankDescription: Create a reusable voice profile to apply consistent tone, vocabulary and brand context across your AI agents.

validate.title: Validate content
validate.subtitle: Add documents, links or indexed content and score how well it fits this persona's audience.

dialogue.title: Persona dialogue
dialogue.subtitle: Pick a topic and two or more personas and watch them talk it through, turn by turn.
dialogue.setupDesc: Each persona must end every reply with a question, so the dialogue keeps flowing.
dialogue.needTwo: You need at least two speaker personas (SPEAKER or BOTH) to run a dialogue.
dialogue.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Should a startup adopt a four-day work week?
dialogue.speakersHint: Pick two or more — the number shows the speaking order.
dialogue.noLlm: No enabled LLM instance is available.

dashboard.systemInstructionHint: The system instruction prepended to chats that adopt this persona.
dashboard.notebookHint: Sources used to score content fit.
dashboard.fitReportHint: How well content matches this audience.

aiChat.panelSubtitle: Describe the voice and I'll draft the persona
aiChat.placeholder: e.g. A senior account executive voice for top-of-funnel demo prospects — concise, persuasive, asks one qualifying question at a time, never quotes prices in the first three turns.
aiChat.empty: Tell me who this persona should sound like — funnel stage, audience, tone — and I'll fill the form on the left.

fromAudio.drafted: Draft persona ready — review and save
fromAudio.failed: Could not derive a persona from the audio

match.title: Persona Match
match.subtitle: Group contents and personas into projects and see, in a matrix, what each content serves each persona for — and vice versa. The analysis runs periodically and re-tunes both sides.
match.emptyDescription: Create a group of contents and personas to generate the N×N report.
match.defaultSubtitle: Select contents and personas, and generate the N×N fit matrix.
match.newHeroSubtitle: Name the project. Then add contents and personas to generate the N×N matrix.
match.projectSectionDesc: Name and description of the analysis project.
match.contentsDesc: URL, indexed content or file. Added once per project — not per persona.
match.noContents: No content yet. Add the first one below.
match.personasDesc: Select the personas this project evaluates. The matrix is the product of contents × personas.
match.settingsDesc: Name, description and how often the analysis re-extracts the contents and recomputes the cells that changed.
match.resultsDesc: What each content serves each persona for — and what each persona serves each content for.
match.emptyPrompt: Add at least one content and one persona, then click Run analysis.
match.readyPrompt: {{count}} cells ready to evaluate ({{sources}} × {{personas}}). Click Run analysis.
match.nothingToAdjust: Nothing to adjust — content well aligned to this persona.
match.reportByContentSub: What each content serves each persona for.
match.reportByPersonaSub: What each persona serves each content for.
match.reportFooter: Report generated from the N×N fit matrix. Percentages combine deterministic readability and LLM evaluation.
match.validatePreparing: Preparing the fit matrix for {{name}} in Persona Match.

dialogueProject.title: Persona dialogue
dialogueProject.subtitle: Save dialogue projects — a topic and a roster of speaker personas — and watch them talk it through, turn by turn. Re-open and re-run any project.
dialogueProject.emptyDescription: Create a dialogue: pick a topic and two or more personas.
dialogueProject.defaultSubtitle: Set a topic and pick two or more speakers, then run the dialogue.
dialogueProject.newHeroSubtitle: Name the project. Then set a topic and pick the speakers.
dialogueProject.projectSectionDesc: Name and description of the dialogue project.
dialogueProject.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Should a startup adopt a four-day work week?
dialogueProject.speakersDesc: Pick two or more personas. The number shows the speaking order (round-robin).
dialogueProject.noSpeakers: No speaker personas available. Create SPEAKER or BOTH personas first.
dialogueProject.settingsDesc: The topic seeds the first turn; each persona must end every reply with a question so the dialogue keeps flowing.
dialogueProject.transcriptDesc: The live conversation. Re-running replaces it.
dialogueProject.transcriptEmpty: No conversation yet. Set a topic, pick speakers and run the dialogue.
dialogueProject.needTwo: Pick at least two speakers to run the dialogue.
